content: {"save": ["The sanctuary shrine bell sits on a tile at (11, 1), east of the river; reaching it requires crossing/going east from the river area.", "Movement to the shrine bell is achieved with DPad directions (Up, Right) plus ControllerA interactions; the bell tile is reached by walking onto it, not by a special command."], "persona": ["When given a reach-a-tile goal, navigate with directional DPad inputs and use ControllerA for interactions; verify arrival by standing on the target tile.", "Short sequences of directional moves plus an interact press are often enough to complete simple navigation goals; don't overcomplicate with extra actions."]}
